subject: how to change reference category in logistic regression

messages.author: 81d04b0fb93693f9
messages.subject: how to change reference category in logistic regression
parts:
Hi,
 
I am working on logistic regression.
One thing I can not figure out is how to change reference catgegory.
By looking at the output, first category looks like a reference level.
How can I change it from first to last?
 
Thanks,
JD

messages.author: 267c7c6c510dc8a2
messages.subject: Re: how to change reference category in logistic regression
parts:
enter the following into the console:

options("contrasts"=c(unordered="contr.SAS",ordered="contr.poly" ))

this will make all subsequent models use the last category as
reference by default. The following reverses the operation:

options("contrasts"=c(unordered="contr.treatment",ordered="contr.poly" ))

parts:
It does work in the Deducer console (AKA JGR), just enter it into the
bottom box. Perhaps you are referring to the outcome variable... The
definition of a success can be changed by clicking the "split" button.

ian
